faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before collaborating

q1.question: What types of collaborations do you offer?
q1.answer: I offer content creation (videos, reels, stories), sports social media consulting, basketball event hosting, and Pimp My Court projects (court renovation). Each collaboration is tailored to your specific goals.

q2.question: How does a collaboration work?
q2.answer: We start with a scoping call to understand your objectives and budget. I then send a detailed creative proposal. Once approved, I produce the content and you receive a performance report after publication.

q3.question: What platforms do you publish on?
q3.answer: I'm active on YouTube (113K subscribers), Instagram (71K followers) and TikTok. I can create content tailored to each platform or produce content for your own channels.

q4.question: What's the production timeline?
q4.answer: Allow 2 to 4 weeks depending on project complexity. A simple product placement reel can be delivered in 1 week. A Pimp My Court project requires several months of preparation.

q5.question: Can you create content outside of basketball?
q5.answer: My expertise and audience are basketball-focused, which is what makes my content powerful. However, I'm open to lifestyle, sports or streetwear brands looking to reach the basketball community.

q6.question: Do you offer recurring partnerships?
q6.answer: Yes, I offer long-term partnerships with monthly or quarterly packages. This is often more effective than one-off collaborations to build a real presence with my community.
